listing.name: MoreVanillaBounties
listing.summary: Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and More Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)
listing.aiSummary: Increases the minimum and maximum values of vanilla bounties by three times and adds new bounty types for Remnants, Derelicts, Pathers, and Mercenaries.

description: Triples the min and max values for standard vanilla bounties. Introduces additional bounty categories including Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary types. Includes functional scaling and a 30-day duration for these missions.
